output.title: botsmith – Docs-Grounded Support Chatbot
output.tagline: Every answer cites its source — or hands off to a human.
output.description_short: Build a citation-enforced support chatbot from your docs in 5 minutes. Resolves tickets without hallucinating. Free up to 200 chats/month.
output.description_long:
**botsmith** turns your docs, help articles, and past tickets into a support chatbot that cannot make things up.

Paste a sitemap URL and your bot is answering questions in about **5 minutes** — no training UI to babysit, no prompt engineering required.

**What makes botsmith different:**
- **Citation-forced answers.** Every reply links the exact source passage it drew from. If retrieval confidence is too low, the bot refuses to guess and escalates to a human instead.
- **Confidence-gated handoff.** No more bots that confidently invent wrong answers. botsmith hands off rather than hallucinate — protecting customer trust, not just deflection rates.
- **Proven deflection.** Pixelhaven resolved 61% of inbound chats end-to-end. 100% of shipped answers carry source citations by construction.

Embeds as a website widget or plugs into your existing helpdesk. Built for support and product teams at SaaS companies with substantial documentation.

**Note:** Multilingual support and voice channels are not yet available. Enterprise security documentation is in progress.

Start free — up to 200 chats/month, no credit card required.
screenshot_order: 1st: The citation UI — show a live chat answer with the source passage highlighted and linked. This is the core differentiator and must be the first thing a buyer sees.
2nd: Setup flow — the sitemap URL input field and the 5-minute onboarding sequence, proving the speed claim visually.
3rd: Escalation handoff screen — show the confidence-gated human handoff in action, reinforcing the no-hallucination guarantee for skeptical buyers.

faq.q: How does botsmith prevent hallucinated answers?
faq.a: Every answer must cite the source passage it came from. If retrieval confidence falls below threshold, the bot escalates to a human instead of improvising — by architectural design, not a setting.

faq.q: How long does setup actually take?
faq.a: Paste your sitemap URL and botsmith indexes your docs automatically. Median time from sitemap to first answered question is 5 minutes. No training UI, no manual tagging.

faq.q: Does it work with my existing helpdesk?
faq.a: Yes. botsmith embeds as a website widget or integrates with existing helpdesk tools. Check the integrations page for the current connector list.

faq.q: What happens when the bot can't answer confidently?
faq.a: It says so and hands the conversation to a human agent. It will not guess. This is the core trust guarantee — your customers never get a confident wrong answer.

faq.q: Is multilingual or voice support available?
faq.a: Not yet. botsmith currently supports English-language text chat. Multilingual and voice channels are on the roadmap.

output.cta: Start free — your first 200 chats are on us.
